title: Mitchell rank for supercompactness
summary: This paper defines a Mitchell rank for supercompact cardinals. If $κ$ is a $θ$-supercompact cardinal then $o_{θ-sc}(κ) = \sup \{ o_{θ-sc}(μ) + 1 \ | \ μ\in m(κ)\}$, where $m(κ)$ is the collection of normal fine measures on $P_κθ$. We show how to force to kill the degree of a measurable cardinal $κ$ to any specified degree which is less than or equal to the degree of $κ$ in the ground model.
